claims.text: The captured notes list v0.38.0 (Aug 20) with a WaitFor tool for background-task completion in-turn and 13 new Kimi Datasource data sources.
v0.37.0 (Aug 18) adds multi-skill activation per prompt, queued skill commands, session Done/Workspaces tabs, /reload, kimi doctor, and Windows fail-early on missing Git Bash.

limitations.text: Behavioral/quality effects of the new tools are undescribed beyond feature statements.
limitations.context: Evidence boundary retained for downstream editorial use.

targets.target: The official Kimi Code release-note page lists v0.38.0 on Aug 20 and v0.37.0 on Aug 18, including a WaitFor tool, additional data sources, multi-skill activation, and Windows CLI auto-update. Candidate-level scope and chronology still require Evidence review.
targets.finding: Official release-note page confirms both versions, dates, and the listed scope (WaitFor, data sources, multi-skill, session management, Windows update).
